samples.summaryVi: Học online giúp linh hoạt giờ học; cần thảo luận và hỗ trợ để tránh học một mình.

paragraphs.label: Nhận lời
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for inviting me to an online study workshop. I would love to come. I have been interested in online university classes for some time, so I am glad we will have a chance to explore it together.
paragraphs.noteVi: Cảm ơn và trả lời trực tiếp lời mời.

paragraphs.label: Đi lại
paragraphs.text: I can meet you at the community centre on Saturday at nine in the morning. I am planning to take the bus and arrive ten minutes early. If the time or meeting point changes, please send me a message before I leave home.
paragraphs.noteVi: Lịch hẹn và phương án cập nhật.

paragraphs.label: Chuẩn bị và hỗ trợ
paragraphs.text: I understand that we will try a short recorded lesson and discuss it in a small group. I can bring headphones, but could you let me know if anything else is needed? One useful point is that students can fit learning around work and family responsibilities. For example, a student who works in a restaurant can review a morning lecture after the evening shift. I would also be happy to help arrange the seats or hand out materials before the session begins.
paragraphs.noteVi: Hỏi rõ chuẩn bị, nối với nội dung sự kiện.

paragraphs.label: Kết thư
paragraphs.text:
Thanks again for thinking of me. It will be lovely to spend time together and learn something practical. Let me know whether you would like me to arrive earlier to help.

Best wishes,
Minh
